lines.japanese: 「まあ制服来て学校行ってバイトして、学生サンは大変だわな。んで、休日はどんなカンジ？」
lines.english: “Wearing a uniform, going to school, working a job... Students have it rough. So what do you do on your days off?”

lines.japanese: 「何そのお見合いみたいな質問」
lines.english: “What, are you interviewing me for marriage?”

lines.japanese: 話題に困って聞いたのがバレバレだった。
lines.english: It was painfully obvious I'd asked because I couldn't think of anything else to say.

lines.japanese: 「そーねー、休みったら、ひとりでブラブラするカンジかな」
lines.english: “Let's see... On days off, I guess I just wander around by myself.”

lines.japanese: ひとりで？
lines.english: By herself?

lines.japanese: 「へえ。意外」
lines.english: “Huh. Didn't expect that.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なんで？」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえ友達多そうだし、ソロ活動嫌いそうだし」
lines.english: “You seem like you've got lots of friends, and you don't seem like the solo type.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、たしかにひとりは好きくないけど、友達はぜんぜん多くないよ」
lines.english: “Mm, I definitely don't like being alone, but I don't have lots of friends at all.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかあ？」
lines.english: “Really?”

lines.japanese: 「俺が知ってるだけでも、鳳（兄）ンとこの連中とか、いっぱいいるじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Even I know you've got all those people in Naru's brother's crowd.”

lines.japanese: 「ＬＲさんたち？　あのひとら、私の友達じゃなくてカズ君の友達だよ」
lines.english: “LR and the others? They’re Kazu’s friends, not mine.”

lines.japanese: 「つまりおまえの友達でもあるじゃん」
lines.english: “Which makes them your friends too.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　そかな……？　友達……んー、なんかしっくり来ないかもー」
lines.english: “Huh? Does it...? Friends... Mm, that doesn't quite feel right.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃおまえがそう思ってるだけで、向こうはそう思ってねーだろ」
lines.english: “You're the only one who thinks that. I doubt they feel the same.”

lines.japanese: あれ……言いながら自分のセリフに既視感。
lines.english: Wait... As I spoke, my own words felt strangely familiar.

lines.japanese: ああ、そういや同じようなこと前によく言われたな、俺も。
lines.english: Oh, right. People used to tell me much the same thing.

lines.japanese: 「そっか、こういうことだったのか」
lines.english: “So that's what they meant.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　なにが？」
lines.english: “Huh? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんでも。やっぱ亜衣は友達多いだろって話」
lines.english: “Nothing. I mean you do have lots of friends.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかあ……うん、だよね、隼人君もその中のひとりだしね」
lines.english: “I guess... Yeah. And you're one of them, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: これも前に言われたことだ。
lines.english: Someone had said that to me before too.

lines.japanese: あのときはなんだか妙にくすぐったくて、冗談まぎれに否定してしまったけれど──
lines.english: Back then, the idea had made me so strangely self-conscious that I'd jokingly denied it—

lines.japanese: 「そうだな」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: ──いまは素直に首肯できた。
lines.english: —but now I could accept it without a fuss.

lines.japanese: 「へへー、ともだちともだち」
lines.english: “Hehe. Friends, friends.”

lines.japanese: 「突付くな。ああもう、時間だし行くわ」
lines.english: “Quit poking me. Ah, damn, look at the time. I gotta go.”

lines.japanese: だけどやっぱりくすぐったくなって、俺はさっさとその場を逃げだしてしまった。
lines.english: It still made me self-conscious enough that I hurried away from her.

lines.japanese: 「ともだち……」
lines.english: “Friends...”
